extent_definitions.built_up: The physically developed area — buildings, roads and immediate curtilage. The smallest of the three measures.
extent_definitions.municipal: The settlement's declared municipal boundary, within which it may plan and build. Typically several times larger than the built-up area.
extent_definitions.regional_council: The jurisdiction of the regional council the settlement belongs to. Covers a large share of Area C, including land not built on and land cultivated by Palestinians.

mechanisms.label: Depopulated in 1948
mechanisms.note: Localities depopulated during and after the 1948 war. Around 750,000 Palestinians were displaced. Property was subsequently vested in the state under the Absentees' Property Law 1950. This is a documented historical event; it is not the same legal category as the settlements.

mechanisms.label: Israeli settlement (post-1967)
mechanisms.note: Israeli settlements in territory occupied since 1967. Unlawful under international law per UN Security Council Resolution 2334 (2016) and the ICJ advisory opinion of 19 July 2024.
